tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card, and the sidebar (the sidebar is not a separate panel).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the record table and form bodies.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers, card footers, read-only values, tags and hover fills.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs, selects and text areas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, the sidebar rule. Decorative only, never a control's edge.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and the switch track: at least 3:1 on input, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on canvas, surface, surface-subtle, input and violet-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, breadcrumbs, metadata, table headers; on canvas, surface, surface-subtle and input.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar link text on canvas.

tokens.name: nav-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar group headings and the account line, on canvas.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: The current sidebar item's fill: a raised tile on canvas.

tokens.name: nav-active-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the current sidebar item, on nav-active.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary button fill and the checked switch. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a violet fill. Never hard-code white: dark mode uses deep ink.

tokens.name: violet-ink
tokens.usage: Links, the Open action in tables, active status text; on surface and violet-soft.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind violet-ink: the selected table row and the accent status pill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline, 2px offset, and the focused control's border. At least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors, alert text and the Delete button's text and border; on surface, input and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of alert messages and the danger status pill.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of alert messages.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icon (Changes saved.), on success-soft and surface.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of status messages and the success pill.

tokens.name: success-line
tokens.usage: Border of status messages.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholders for short values such as IDs.

tokens.name: skeleton-strong
tokens.usage: Loading placeholders for longer values such as names.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the resource or record name in the page header.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and section headings: Edit project, Actions, Delete project.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Choose a resource to open its workspace.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, nav items, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table column headers, sidebar group headings, pills. The smallest size allowed.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Model identities, record IDs, JSON in action inputs.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Identity chips beside a page title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in pills; error list rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between inline controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar controls; table cell rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a form and between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Main content padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Separation between page regions on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code and small tags inside dense text.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, text areas, nav items, messages.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: the modular unit of every screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, the value-handling select, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card, so cards float on the canvas. Never on controls.

tokens.name: shadow-nav-active
tokens.usage: The current sidebar item's raised tile.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Open menus and popovers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, selects and default buttons (the minimum pointer target).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar controls and small buttons.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: The value-handling select in a field header only.

tokens.name: nav-item
tokens.usage: Height of a sidebar link.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of a record table row.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: form-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a standalone create or edit form; 370px when docked beside a table.
